Executed 18 of 60 in-sprint test cases (30%) as ADMIN_USER on the live Holiday module. Identified 5 distinct defects -- 3 P1 (SN2-BE001, SN2-BE002, SN2-FE001), 1 P2, 1 P3. The run is dominated by environment blockers: 35 BLOCKED and 7 DEFERRED TCs. Two P1s gate everything else: SN2-BE002 (the National list returns 0 seeded rows and errors with a retry storm, blocking the entire National-tab + waiver surface) and SN2-BE001 (the Add Holiday CREATE call fails, so no Company/Special row can be created to exercise edit / delete / view-modal TCs). Until these are fixed, only the Add-modal chrome, validation gaps, and page chrome are testable.

#1 SN2-BE001 SNOPS-64 P1

SN2-BE001 -- Add holiday save fails with generic error on all tabs

Clicking Save on the Add Holiday modal with a valid Company holiday (name "QA Founding Day", date 2027-03-15, company_holiday, paid, Company Default scope) returns an inline error: "Couldn't save the holiday. Something went wrong. Please try again." No holiday is created. Reproduced on the Company tab; the same CREATE path backs the Special tab. The Holiday CREATE endpoint is broken in QA, which cascades into every create/edit/delete/view TC that needs a real row first.

Affected Test Cases

  • TC-019 -- Add company holiday -- save step (primary)
  • TC-020 -- Add special holiday (same CREATE path)
  • TC-026 -- Edit company holiday (no row to edit)
  • TC-028 -- Delete company holiday (no row to delete)

Spec refs

[HOL-9.5], [HOL-9.7], [HOL-9.8]

Evidence

#2 SN2-BE002 SNOPS-67 P1

SN2-BE002 -- National holidays fail to load; 0 seeded rows for TH 2026 / 2027

The National tab renders a "Couldn't load holidays." error panel with a Retry button. GET /core/api/v1/holidays?entityId=...0d0004&year=2026&source=National returns 0 rows, and the request fires in a retry storm (hundreds of calls, most net::ERR_ABORTED). Banner reads "0 national holidays · 0 included · 0 tagged public_holiday". The 18 mandated TH-2026 statutory holidays (and the 2027 set) are absent -- either PolicyCore seeding never ran for this entity or the list endpoint is failing. Blocks the entire National-tab surface and the floor/waiver flows.

Affected Test Cases

  • TC-006 -- National tab loads 18 seeded rows (primary)
  • TC-007 -- Year selector refresh (row counts unverifiable)
  • TC-009 -- Visakha Bucha substitute (no rows)

Spec refs

[HOL-9.1], [HOL-8.1], [HOL-9.2]

Evidence

#3 SN2-FE001 SNOPS-69 P1

SN2-FE001 -- "Public holiday" day_type option missing from Company tab Add Holiday modal

The Add Holiday modal on the Company tab shows only "Company holiday" in the Type radiogroup -- the "Public holiday" option is absent. The Special tab modal correctly shows both. Per [HOL-7.4] the catalog is public_holiday + company_holiday; an admin currently cannot create a company-scoped public holiday from the Company tab, and TC-021 (dropdown contents) cannot pass.

Affected Test Cases

  • TC-021 -- day_type dropdown shows exactly two options (primary)
  • TC-019 -- Company modal presets
  • TC-022 -- Switching day_type locks/unlocks

Spec refs

[HOL-7.4], [HOL-2.2.5], [HOL-15.9]

Evidence

#4 SN2-FE002 SNOPS-71 P2

SN2-FE002 -- Year-window validation absent: 2028 not hard-blocked; in-window past date shows no soft warn

The date field in the Add Holiday modal accepts any year with no validation. Entering 2028-01-01 (out of the 2026-2027 window) produces no hard-block error and leaves Save enabled -- spec [HOL-15.7] requires "Year 2028 is not yet seeded. Window: 2026-2027." Entering 2026-03-15 (past, in-window) shows no soft warn -- spec [HOL-15.6] requires the past-date advisory. Both validations are missing.

Affected Test Cases

  • TC-037 -- Out-of-window hard block + past-date soft warn (primary)

Spec refs

[HOL-15.6], [HOL-15.7], [HOL-7.3.2]

Evidence

#5 SN2-FE003 SNOPS-72 P3

SN2-FE003 -- "Type" column present in tables (should be dropped); "Substitute day" column absent

The National table renders 7 columns: HOLIDAY, DATE, DAY, TYPE, APPLIES TO, STATUS, INCLUDE. Spec [HOL-6.4.3] / PM-Sec3 dropped the "Type" column (the downstream contract is day_type, surfaced as a pill, not a "Type" column), and the spec column set expects a "Substitute day" column which is absent. The same "Type" column appears on the Company and Special tables. Cosmetic/contract-naming deviation; affects how the day_type pill is presented (TC-044).

Affected Test Cases

  • TC-008 -- National columns -- no Type column (primary)
  • TC-044 -- day_type pill surface

Spec refs

[HOL-6.4.3], [HOL-9.1]

Recommendations

  1. Fix P1 SN2-BE002 first: seed the TH 2026/2027 statutory list for Test TH Regional via PolicyCore and resolve the list-endpoint error + retry storm. This unblocks ~25 National-tab / waiver TCs.
  2. Fix P1 SN2-BE001: the Holiday CREATE endpoint returns a generic save failure. Unblocks all create/edit/delete/view-modal TCs.
  3. Fix P1 SN2-FE001: restore the "Public holiday" option in the Company-tab Add modal day_type group.
  4. Configure API auth in .env.qa (E2E_API_KEY, E2E_ACTOR_ID, E2E_ACTOR_TYPE_ID, E2E_AUTH_CLIENT_ID) to run the 10 DEFERRED API TCs.
  5. Provision VIEW_ONLY / NO_ACCESS / TOGGLE_NO_WAIVE users and a SECOND_ENTITY to unblock RBAC and entity-switch TCs.
  6. Re-run /qa-test run SN-2 --failed after fixes to verify SN2-BE001, SN2-BE002, SN2-FE001, SN2-FE002 and complete the blocked set.
